title: Bound every three-node line exchange in the seeded BIT component family
body:
All 48 nested placements among 982 paths and 20,394 assignments lose at both rates. Best first-trial signed change is below −34.487478.

## Scope and source

Extends #7930 to three seeded components with fixed exterior and protected main/411 boundary. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit-three-node-line-exchange/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. The 25.07-second cold run reproduced both price methods and exact projector checks with 300 boundary certificates. Hosted execution is separate.
